text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold A, E, and B at gains, but a gain versus my cost is not a reason by itself to sell; I should assess each holding’s forward risk and return.","My account value fell in several periods even after profitable sales, so realized gains on individual stocks do not guarantee good overall performance; I should judge decisions at the portfolio level.","With prices moving randomly and no trades in the later periods, I should avoid reacting to frequent account checks or treating recent price moves as forecasts; trade only when my portfolio assessment warrants it."]}
